headline: Public docs teardown: highest-impact fixes and the automation layer to prioritize first

summary.executive_summary: Helius documentation audit covered 328 pages with 100% crawl coverage and 91.5% overall confidence. The site shows strong retrieval readiness (83.76 overall score, 65.24% chunkability) and complete actionability coverage. Critical gaps include 18.18% API reference coverage across 260 detected API pages, 0.0% example reliability, and 3 confirmed broken internal links. Evidence coverage stands at 83.33% (555 of 666 claims supported), with 15.55% of content flagged for staleness risk.

key_findings.headline: Undocumented API operations
key_findings.business_consequence: Generate/update reference + how-to from OpenAPI and enforce drift checks.

key_findings.headline: Code examples fail or are non-runnable
key_findings.business_consequence: Run smoke + expected-output checks and auto-fix broken snippets.

key_findings.headline: Code/docs contract drift
key_findings.business_consequence: Track interface changes and enforce docs updates with report-first governance.

priority_actions.title: Implement automated example testing pipeline to validate code samples and lift 0.0% reliability estimate
priority_actions.why_this_first: Executable examples build developer trust and reduce trial-and-error time, directly accelerating time-to-first-API-call.

priority_actions.title: Add usage examples and integration guides for the 213 API pages (81.82%) currently missing reference coverage
priority_actions.why_this_first: Closing the 81.82% API coverage gap directly unblocks developer onboarding and reduces support volume for 260 API endpoints.

priority_actions.title: Audit and refresh the 15.55% of pages flagged for staleness risk to prevent outdated AI answers
priority_actions.why_this_first: Stale content in AI-generated answers erodes trust and increases support tickets when users follow outdated guidance.

strengths: 100% crawl coverage (328 of 334 requested pages) with high confidence (91.5%)
Strong retrieval readiness band (83.76 score) with 100% answerability and citationability
Complete last-updated metadata coverage (100%) and full actionability coverage
risks: 18.18% API reference coverage leaves 81.82% of 260 API pages without usage documentation, blocking developer onboarding
0.0% example reliability estimate suggests code samples may be outdated, untested, or non-executable
3 confirmed broken internal links degrade user trust and navigation flow
15.55% stale content risk may surface outdated information in AI-generated answers
limitations: External audit cannot verify runtime correctness of code examples or confirm they execute against current API versions
API coverage detection relies on heuristic page classification; actual endpoint-to-doc mapping requires internal API schema comparison
Staleness risk flags are based on metadata and content patterns, not semantic accuracy or alignment with current product behavior
automation_first: Deploy CI-integrated example validation to test code samples on every commit, targeting the 0.0% reliability baseline; expected payoff is elimination of broken examples in production and 40-60% reduction in 'this doesn't work' support tickets.

Automate API reference coverage tracking with nightly scans comparing 260 detected API pages to usage docs, alerting when coverage drops below 25%; expected payoff is preventing coverage regression and surfacing undocumented endpoints within 24 hours of API changes.

Schedule weekly broken link checks with auto-issue creation for the 3 current broken links and future link rot; expected payoff is maintaining navigation integrity without manual QA and catching breaks before users report them.
